headline: Archaeological Survey of India installs volume knobs on Red Fort ramparts to ensure 'Vande Mataram' reaches every nearby kitchen
body:
The Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) has officially installed 45 high-fidelity, brass-plated volume control dials along the historic Red Fort ramparts, aiming to calibrate the decibel levels of patriotic anthems to match the ambient noise of nearby breakfast preparation. The move follows the 80th Independence Day celebrations, where officials expressed concern that the stirring rendition of 'Vande Mataram' was accidentally being drowned out by the sound of whistling pressure cookers in Old Delhi households.

“We realized that if the anthem is to be truly felt by every citizen, the acoustics need to account for the mid-morning tea rush,” said Ramesh Shastri, a senior heritage acoustic engineer. “By adding these traditional-looking knobs, we can now pivot between a subtle, hummable melody during the flag hoisting and a full-stadium power-chord setting once the breakfast parathas start frying. It’s about creating a seamless integration between national pride and morning chores.”

To ensure the system is operated with appropriate gravity, the ASI has appointed a dedicated 'Nodal Officer of Resonance' whose sole duty is to stand near the main gate with a pair of professional-grade headphones. The official will spend the next three months testing if the rendition can be adjusted to vibrate exactly at the frequency of a perfect tea-steeping process, ensuring maximum synergy between the anthem and the daily routine of the capital.
caption: ASI engineers go the extra mile to ensure national pride is audible in every kitchen. Because nothing pairs better with morning chai than perfectly tuned patriotism. #IndependenceDay #RedFort #India #CivicDuty (satire)
